blast_radius.functions_impossible_without_n8n: None. Every path n8n served is served by first-party code, proven by the 56/56 automation canary.
blast_radius.consumers_beyond_seo: None. No non-SEO n8n consumer ever existed in this repository.
blast_radius.synchronous_production_requests: None. No request path can select an n8n bridge, because the bridge and its selector are deleted.
blast_radius.jobs_lost_on_immediate_shutdown: None on the GPTBot side. A surviving external n8n execution can no longer deliver: the route is 410 and its bearer is unbound.
blast_radius.n8n_can_write_github: No. GPTBot grants no write path, and the only repository writer is a separate admin-authenticated draft import.
blast_radius.n8n_can_auto_publish: No. Automation reaches awaiting_review only; publication is a separate manual action.
blast_radius.missing_ingest_token: Not applicable. The endpoint answers 410 regardless of any binding.
blast_radius.raw_logging: None. The 410 response and the console carry neither the credential nor the request payload, asserted by tests/n8n-retirement.test.ts.

retirement.replacement: Cloudflare Queue + DLQ + Cron + D1 automation ledger (gptbot-automation Worker)
retirement.automation_canary: 56/56 PASS against production D1 and the real Queue/DLQ bindings
retirement.legacy_endpoint_status: permanent 410 Gone; handler deleted, not gated
retirement.external_workflow: Isolated, not verified-disabled: no n8n control-plane credential exists. The route it called is permanently 410, its bearer is neither read nor bound, and no GPTBot runtime file contains the n8n host or the x-runable-secret header, so neither direction can carry traffic. The n8n instance was not deleted; unrelated workflows are out of scope.
retirement.rollback: first-party release rollback only; no n8n reactivation path exists
